hip_batch.boundary: Warm resident forward of 16 N1000 inputs; not E2E; no fixed-GEMM substitution at B8/B16.

e2e.boundary: Complete Rust-measured invocations; same 16 inputs, one model load, B4 versus B16 grouping. Post-measurement reference verification excluded in both arms.
e2e.cache_state: Fresh workers; unflushed caches; offline-built HIP kernels; all checkpoint hashes and exports retained.
e2e.acceptance: Official same-grouping byte equality; no cross-group equality assertion or tolerance relaxation.

independent.decision: Do not promote B16: complete invocation improvement is negligible and one pair regresses.

native.note: Instrumented single-B4 forward. Kernel durations only, not additive with CPU aten aggregates. No hardware-counter roofline classification.

optimized.note: Instrumented single-B4 forward. Kernel durations only, not additive with CPU aten aggregates. No hardware-counter roofline classification.
